/bin/bash -lc "curl -L --fail --retry 2 'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream?compressed=false&format=fasta&query=%28organism_id%3A9606%29%20AND%20%28reviewed%3Atrue%29' -o human_reviewed.fa && wc -c human_reviewed.fa && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
q=''
name=None;s=''
best=[]
def score(a,b):
 # exact longest shared windows and simple matching at aligned starts
 import difflib
 m=difflib.SequenceMatcher(None,a,b,autojunk=False).find_longest_match()
 return m.size,m.a,m.b
for line in Path('human_reviewed.fa').read_text().splitlines()+['>END']:
 if line.startswith('>'):
  if name:
   z=score(q,s)
   best.append((z,len(s),name,s))
  name=line;s=''
 else:s+=line.strip()
for z,l,n,s in sorted(best,reverse=True)[:10]:
 print(z,l,n)
 print(s[max(0,z[2]-10):z[2]+z[0]+10])
PY"
